This card is that route: an issue was filed, and its PR must be **docs-only and carry nothing else**. ⛔ Do not add a changeset, do not touch code, do not fold in any other correction you notice — report those instead.

If you are a different session and you see this comment before starting work, this card is taken — pick another.
